title: 2859. Sum of Values at Indices With K Set Bits

examples.explanation: The binary representation of the indices are: 0 = 0002 1 = 0012 2 = 0102 3 = 0112 4 = 1002 Indices 1, 2, and 4 have k = 1 set bits in their binary representation. Hence, the answer is nums[1] + nums[2] + nums[4] = 13.
The binary representation of the indices are: 0 = 002 1 = 012 2 = 102 3 = 112 Only index 3 has k = 2 set bits in its binary representation. Hence, the answer is nums[3] = 1.
